description: GVP receipt vectors (spec §6.4, §5, §7). Ed25519 cases regenerate byte for byte; the ML-DSA-65 case is verify-only (hedged signature). Each case is a FULL receipt. A conformant verifier rebuilds the payload by the §6.4 table, reproduces expectedPayload byte for byte (null = the table refuses to build one), reaches `expected` (§6.3), and recomputes responseHash (§5) to match responseHashRederives. keyList: "published" = keyList below, "live" = liveKeyList, "none" = integrity-only.
key: vectors/attestation-key.json (throwaway test key, NOT a production key)

cases.name: v1-legacy-matched-by-publicKey
cases.note: No payloadVersion: shape /1, no fixedPointVersion member signed, no keyId (matched by embedded publicKey).

cases.name: v2-fixedpoint-2
cases.note: The shape x402toll.com issues today: /2 signing GVP-FixedPoint/2.

cases.name: v2-anchor-null
cases.note: onChainAnchor null: agentId is JSON null in the payload.

cases.name: v2-anchor-absent
cases.note: No onChainAnchor member: agentId is JSON null in the payload.

cases.name: v3-ml-dsa-65
cases.note: ML-DSA-65 (hedged, so this signature is verify-only and changes on every regeneration). A verifier without ML-DSA-65 reports unverifiable (spec §8).

cases.name: v2-integrity-only-no-key-list
cases.note: No key list: verified against the embedded publicKey, scope integrity (not identity).

cases.name: unbound-issuer-name-changed
cases.note: issuer.name and issuer.url are not signed. Only issuer.service is.

cases.name: unbound-anchor-registry-changed
cases.note: Only onChainAnchor.agentId is signed. A verifier takes registry and chain from its own context, never from the receipt.

cases.name: unbound-signature-signed-and-note-changed
cases.note: signature.signed is an informational recipe, not the authority (spec §6.4 is).

cases.name: hash-bound-result-changed
cases.note: result, canonicalInputs and method are bound only through responseHash: the signature still verifies, and responseHashRederives is false. A verifier MUST run both checks.

cases.name: issuer-as-string
cases.note: issuer must be an object; the payload member comes from issuer.service only.

cases.name: anchor-stripped
cases.note: Stripping the anchor makes agentId null, which is not what was signed.

cases.name: issuedAt-reformatted-same-instant
cases.note: issuedAt is the exact string; a reformatted equal instant is different bytes.

cases.name: fixedPointVersion-stripped
cases.note: No default at L2: the §2.1.1 absent-means-/1 rule is for unsigned use only.

cases.name: payloadVersion-stripped-downgrade
cases.note: Rebuilt as /1, which was not signed. A verifier MUST NOT then try /2.

cases.name: unsigned-receipt
cases.note: L1 only: nothing to attest. A consumer that requires L2 rejects it by its own policy.

cases.name: live-x402toll-receipt

receipt.method: taxable = salary - standardDeduction; federal = marginal 2026 brackets; state = marginal/flat per 51-jurisdiction table (MFJ doubles single thresholds); FICA = 6.2% SS to wage base + 1.45% Medicare + 0.9% additional over threshold; net/check = netAnnual / payPeriods

goldenVector.reference: TX $85k single biweekly -> net $2,639.52/check, fed $9,870.00, FICA $6,502.50 (Reckon VERIFICATION.md 2026-07-08)

howToVerify: 1. Recompute the fixed point: canonical SHA-256 over {endpoint, inputs, result, method, dataVintage} must equal responseHash (sha256:2d0a3094dd057b542aabc49180bd277bf242504d9d91468158f8f3df4a780b62).
2. Re-derive for free: GET https://x402toll.com/v1/golden/paycheck returns the canonical (inputs -> result -> hash); confirms the math without trusting the issuer.
3. Tamper-check a stored copy: POST {response, inputs} to https://x402toll.com/v1/verify-hash.
4. Issuer identity is on-chain: ERC-8004 agentId 59110 in registry 0x8004A169FB4a3325136EB29fA0ceB6D2e539a432 on eip155:8453.
5. The signature (if present) attests WHO issued this receipt and WHEN — not that the answer is correct. Correctness is proven by steps 1-3.
receipt.disclaimer: Estimates only — not financial, legal, or tax advice. Computed from published 2026 datasets and stated formulas; verify with a qualified professional before acting.

signature.signed: canonicalJson({responseHash, endpoint, dataVintage, issuer, agentId, issuedAt, payloadVersion, fixedPointVersion}) — GVP-Attestation/2
signature.note: Attests issuance (who + when) and binds fixedPointVersion, not correctness. Correctness is proven by recompute-trust (responseHash + golden vector).

cases.note: A paid mainnet receipt from x402toll.com (2026-11-18, the one reproduced on x402-foundation/x402#2887), against its /.well-known/gvp-keys.json.

revocationCases.name: tampered-list-unverifiable
revocationCases.note: Removing an entry breaks the signature; the status is unverifiable, never not-revoked.

revocationCases.name: entry-kind-null-unverifiable
revocationCases.note: kind must be absent, "responseHash" or "reportHash"; any other value (null included) makes the list malformed.
